chorus.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Let's count to a hun-dred, you and me, / one, two, three, as fun as can be! / Step by step we climb up high, / one hun-dred num-bers to the sky!

n1.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n1.lyrics: one, two, three, four, five, / six, sev-en, eight, nine, ten! / Ten! Clap your hands!

n2.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n2.lyrics: e-lev-en, twelve, thir-teen, four-teen, fif-teen, / six-teen, sev-en-teen, eight-een, nine-teen, twen-ty! / Twen-ty! Stomp your feet!

n3.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n3.lyrics: twen-ty one, twen-ty two, twen-ty three, twen-ty four, twen-ty five, / twen-ty six, twen-ty sev-en, twen-ty eight, twen-ty nine, thir-ty! / Thir-ty! Jump up high!

n4.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n4.lyrics: thir-ty one, thir-ty two, thir-ty three, thir-ty four, thir-ty five, / thir-ty six, thir-ty sev-en, thir-ty eight, thir-ty nine, for-ty! / For-ty! Wig-gle, wig-gle!

n5.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n5.lyrics: for-ty one, for-ty two, for-ty three, for-ty four, for-ty five, / for-ty six, for-ty sev-en, for-ty eight, for-ty nine, fif-ty! / Fif-ty! Half-way there!

n6.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n6.lyrics: fif-ty one, fif-ty two, fif-ty three, fif-ty four, fif-ty five, / fif-ty six, fif-ty sev-en, fif-ty eight, fif-ty nine, six-ty! / Six-ty! Spin a-round!

n7.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n7.lyrics: six-ty one, six-ty two, six-ty three, six-ty four, six-ty five, / six-ty six, six-ty sev-en, six-ty eight, six-ty nine, sev-en-ty! / Sev-en-ty! Touch your nose!

n8.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n8.lyrics: sev-en-ty one, sev-en-ty two, sev-en-ty three, sev-en-ty four, sev-en-ty five, / sev-en-ty six, sev-en-ty sev-en, sev-en-ty eight, sev-en-ty nine, eigh-ty! / Eigh-ty! Wave hel-lo!

n9.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n9.lyrics: eigh-ty one, eigh-ty two, eigh-ty three, eigh-ty four, eigh-ty five, / eigh-ty six, eigh-ty sev-en, eigh-ty eight, eigh-ty nine, nine-ty! / Nine-ty! Al-most there!

n10.chords: C | G | F | C | G | C
n10.lyrics: nine-ty one, nine-ty two, nine-ty three, nine-ty four, nine-ty five, / nine-ty six, nine-ty sev-en, nine-ty eight, nine-ty nine, one hun-dred! / One hun-dred! Hoo-ray, we did it!

tens.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
tens.lyrics: Now count by tens, it's quick and fun! / Ten, twen-ty, thir-ty, here we come! / For-ty, fif-ty, six-ty, sev-en-ty, / eigh-ty, nine-ty, one hun-dred, yay!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q2.lyrics: What comes af-ter thir-ty nine? / For-ty!

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: What comes af-ter fif-ty? / Fif-ty one!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: What comes af-ter nine-ty nine? / One hun-dred!

actions.chords: C | G | F | C | C | G | F | C
actions.lyrics: Clap for ten and stomp for twen-ty, / jump for thir-ty, we've got plen-ty! / Spin for for-ty, wave for fif-ty, / one hun-dred, aren't we nif-ty!

karaoke.chords: C | G | F | C | Am | F | G | C

slow.chords: C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G
slow.lyrics: Let's count by tens slow-ly! / Ten, twen-ty / Thir-ty, for-ty / Fif-ty, six-ty / Sev-en-ty, eigh-ty, nine-ty, one hun-dred!
